referenceFunction.generalComment: Manufacturing process is considered with consumption of raw materials, energy, infrastructure and land use, as well as the generation of emissions to air.Transportation of raw materials is also included. Auxiliaries, solid wastes and emissions to water are not included due to the lack of information. Transport and storage of the final product are not included. No byproducts or coproducts are considered. Transcient or unstable operations are not considered, but the production during stable operation conditions. Emissions to air are considered as emanating in a high population density area. Inventory refers to 1 kg 100% urea-formaldehyde resin. The literature source used are Diem 2000 and von Däniken et al. 1995.; UUID: b32ef554-1bd6-38ba-be42-4b6c572a019c
referenceFunction.name: Melamine formaldehyde resin, at plant

geography.text: For raw materials, data are taken from literature and refere to u-f resin. The other values are an approximation based on the manufacturing of alkyl resin. For this alkyl resin, data base on information provided by a European manufacturing company. It is not known how representative are these values for the European melamine-formaldehyde resin industry

timePeriod.text: The literature sources are from 1995 and 2000. The time period to which the data presented in the sources corresponds is not known.

representativeness.extrapolations: Transports based on standard distances of Ecoinvent. Infrastructure: proxy module used (chemical plant, organics)
